sources.title: Alolan Persian — Sun & Moon 79/149（Taunt）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-07 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: “Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.”：由使用招式的玩家选对方 1 只备战宝可梦，与对方战斗宝可梦交换。新写法 “Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.” 意思相同。

sources.title: Gothitelle — Sun & Moon Guardians Rising 54/145（Tractorbeam）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-07 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: “Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon.”：先换位，再对新的战斗宝可梦造成伤害（换位写在伤害前 BEFORE_ATTACK）。

sources.title: Pokémon Catcher — Sun & Moon 126/149
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-07 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: 物品 “Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.”：正面时由使用者选对方备战宝可梦换上（coin_flip 的 heads 分支里放 gust）。

dataContractZh: 新效果 gust：target 只能是 SELECT_OPPONENT_POKEMON，不接受参数。与 switch（选自己的备战宝可梦）、force_switch（由对方自己选）并列。
serverAuthorityZh: 服务器只把对方当前的备战宝可梦作为候选，提示发给效果操控方；确认后用与 force_switch 相同的服务器换位（不是撤退，不付费用，原战斗宝可梦的特殊状态与攻击效果清除）。对方没有备战宝可梦时这一步不产生作用。
limitations: “During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.” 等对“被换上的那只”施加的后续效果，若写成 OPPONENT_ACTIVE 即指换上后的战斗宝可梦。
